declarations.description:
Wraps any element and pins a solid dot or count to one of its edges: unread messages on an inbox button, presence on
an avatar, a "new" marker on a tab. The wrapped element goes in the default slot and keeps its own semantics; the
indicator is drawn over it at one of eight `position`s, written in logical terms (`top-end` is the top-right corner
in a left-to-right page and the top-left one in a right-to-left page).

With no `count` and nothing in the `label` slot the indicator is a dot. A `count` is clamped at `max` (`99+`) and a
count of `0` hides the indicator unless `show-zero` is set; `invisible` hides it with a short scale-out, for a
notification that has been read. Because a bare number next to a button means little to a screen reader, give
`accessible-label` a phrase such as `{count} unread messages`: it replaces the visible text in the accessibility tree.

Compared with the `anchor` slot of `c2-badge`, which pins a tinted label to one of four corners, `c2-indicator` wraps
its target, draws a solid marker, adds the centre and middle positions, follows the writing direction and names its
count for assistive technology. For a round target such as an avatar, set both offsets to `14.6%` to move the
indicator onto the circle.
declarations.name: Indicator

cssProperties.description: Height of a count or label indicator.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--height

cssProperties.description: Ring separating the indicator from the wrapped element, in the page background colour. Drawn outside a dot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--border

cssProperties.description: Stacking order of the indicator over the wrapped element.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--z-index

cssProperties.description: Moves the indicator inwards from the inline edge it is pinned to. `14.6%` puts it on the edge of a round target.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--offset-x

cssProperties.description: Moves the indicator inwards from the block edge it is pinned to. `14.6%` puts it on the edge of a round target.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--offset-y

cssProperties.description: Diameter of the dot, not counting the ring.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator__dot--size

cssProperties.description: Size of an `<svg>` icon in the `label` slot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator__icon--size

cssProperties.description: Length of one `pulse` cycle; respects reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator__pulse--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Scale-in and scale-out when the indicator appears or hides; respects reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-indicator--transition-duration

cssParts.description: The dot or count drawn over the wrapped element.
cssParts.name: indicator

slots.description: The element the indicator is pinned to.
Custom indicator content, such as an icon or a short word. Ignored while `count` is set.
slots.name: label

members.name: position
members.description: Edge or corner of the wrapped element the indicator is pinned to, in logical terms (`end` follows the writing direction).

members.name: count
members.description: Number to display. Without it, and with nothing in the `label` slot, the indicator is a dot.

members.name: max
members.description: Upper bound for `count`; larger values render as `<max>+`.

members.name: invisible
members.description: Hides the indicator, for example once its notifications have been read.

members.name: pulse
members.description: Animates a fading ring around the indicator to draw attention, such as a live or processing state.

members.name: accessibleLabel
members.description:
Text announced in place of the visible indicator, such as `{count} unread messages`; `{count}` is replaced by the
displayed count. Without it the visible text, if any, is exposed as is and a dot is not announced.

members.name: displayCount
members.description: Text shown for `count`, clamped at `max`. Empty without a count.

members.name: shown
members.description: Whether the indicator is currently shown.
